scenario.title: The Missing Courier
scenario.player_role: You are Rook, an investigator following the route of a missing courier.
scenario.premise: The courier should have reached Greyhaven yesterday. Something happened along the isolated road.
scenario.objective: Follow the courier's route, discover what happened, and return with an answer.
scenario.scope_note: This is a short, bounded investigation. Each scene introduces one part of the RPG rules.

roadside-tracks.title: Roadside Tracks
roadside-tracks.opening_fiction: At a bend in the old road, Rook finds churned mud, a broken strap, and tracks leading away from the road.

frightened-witness.title: Frightened Witness
frightened-witness.opening_fiction: Farther along the road, Rook finds a shaken witness who may have seen the courier leave the route.

washed-out-path.title: Washed-Out Path
washed-out-path.opening_fiction: The search reaches a washed-out stretch where unstable ground blocks the easiest way forward.

bandit-scout.title: Bandit Scout
bandit-scout.opening_fiction: Beyond the damaged path, Rook spots a bandit scout near the courier's trail.

resolve-bandit-next-turn.label: See if the bandit can recover

roadside-tracks:action->frightened-witne.bridge_text: Rook presses on and soon finds a frightened witness who may know more about the courier's route.

frightened-witness:action->washed-out-pa.bridge_text: Rook continues along the route until a washed-out stretch of road blocks the way ahead.

washed-out-path:action->bandit-scout:act.bridge_text: Past the damaged ground, the trail brings Rook face to face with a bandit scout.

bandit-scout:action->bandit-scout:recove.bridge_text: The exchange ends with the bandit injured. The next moment will determine whether the scout can keep fighting.
